title: Road manifest
content:
[TRADER] Road manifest

## General Introduction Road manifests are submitted by Declarants and CFAs. In road manifest amendment and cancellation can be done unless it has been used in the declaration and pass release. ## Front End User The user needs to log into eCMS using the URL: www.ecms.gov.bt ## Click on login menu and provide the required credentials to log in to the system: Create Road Manifest ## Select Road Manifest for the list of menus provided in the dashboard as highlighted below: Under the Road Manifest menu, Select Create Road Manifest: ## Key in the following details: Road Manifest Header Select the Regime as import, export, transit, temporary import, temporary export, re-import and re-export, warehousing and fill in the details >> Save the details: ## Invoice Details Add New invoice and either save or save and go to the next page: ## Supporting Documents Details The declarant shall attach any supporting documents (invoice, packing list etc) for approval: ## Summary The declarant can review his/her road manifest declaration and submit the same for approval: ## Track Application An application Number will be Generated: ## The users will be able to track their application from Search Road Manifest: Update Road Manifest and Update Road Manifest Vehicle: User can apply for update of Road manifest in general or can apply update for just vehicle mentioned in the RM due to certain reasons. ## The road manifest is not used in a declaration or The consignment against the road manifest has not exited the country. ## Cancel Road Manifest User can cancel the Road Manifest that has already submitted and approved due to certain user error: The below screen will be provided for the user to do the cancel of a particular RM by providing the reason and remarks: ## My Party Road Manifest This tab gives the user the list of RM till date submitted by the user profile:

title: Declaration
content:
[TRADER] Declaration

## General Introduction The declaration submission is the first step in the eCMS System. After submission, the declaration goes through processing by various department of Customs. This document also illustrates the overall processing of the various regimes supported by eCMS. ## Login as Front-end user The user needs to log into eCMS using the url: www.ecms.gov.bt ## Click on login menu and provide the required credentials to log in to the system: Declaration ## Select Declaration FE for the list of menus provided in the dashboard: Search Async Declaration: provides list of declaration that has been created, submitted from the initial to till date by the user for a particular party. ## Search and Edit Declaration: Provided the list for the following: Submitted Declaration list: list of declaration that has been submitted by the FE user. Draft declaration list: list of declaration that’s in draft state. ## Create Declaration Allows the user to create the declaration by selecting different regime. Once the regime is selected accordingly Declaration Type for each regime is populated. Selection of declaration type based on the regime selected. Continue with the filling of details in each tab. ## The regime and their declaration type are as follows: Based on the selection of the regime and declaration type the different tab details needs to be filled in. ## General Information: Select the Regime as Import >> Select Declaration type as per the requirement and get the details filled and save the data that has been completed. ## Bill of Lading The user needs to add in the Bill of landing wherein we must have Road Manifest details, that has been created and approved before the declaration is created: At times we have a container associated in the consignment, the details of the container will then have the be added under the Bill of Lading, into the Container details: ## Invoice and Consignor Add New invoice and consignor details >> add in the invoice details and commodities details >> Save ## Supporting Documents The declarant shall attach mandatory supporting documents (invoice) for approval: ## Summary The declarant can review his/her declaration summary and submit the same for approval, here we have the check box to accept the terms and condition. Here the user can validate the declaration before submission. The user can submit the declaration which will allow the user to generate the reference declaration number. ## Search Amendment Request Provide the list of declaration that has been requested for amendment. ## Create Amendment Request From the list of declaration, one can request for amendment. Click on the declaration for which amendment is required. Select the reasons from the dropdown list. Provide the remarks for amendment. Press submit button. ## Search Cancellation Provide the list of declaration that has been requested for cancellation. ## Create Cancellation From the list of declaration, one can request for cancellation. Click on the declaration for which cancellation is required. Select the reasons from the dropdown list. Provide the remarks for cancellation. Press submit button. ## Search Transit Amendment Provide the list of declaration with regime Transit that has been requested for amendment. ## Create Transit Amendment From the list of transit declaration, one can request for cancellation. Click on the declaration for which cancellation is required. Select the reasons from the dropdown list. Provide the remarks for amendment. Press submit button. ## Search Post Entry Declaration Provide the list of declaration that has been post entry declaration. ## Search Post Entry Cancellation Provide the list of declaration that has been requested cancellation of post entry declaration. ## Create Post Entry Cancellation From the list of declaration, one can request for post entry cancellation. Click on the declaration for which cancellation is required. Select the reasons from the dropdown list. Provide the remarks for cancellation. ## Press submit button Track Application ## An application Number will be Generated: The users will be able to track their application from Search and Edit Declaration: ## Search amendment request User are provided view of the list of declaration that has been for amendment ## Create Amendment request User can request for amendment of declaration that title: eCMS Bhutan :: Web Portal of Electronic Customs Management System
content: Vision, Mission & Core Values Vision A sustained economic growth with stable macroeconomic environment through dynamic fiscal policy and prudent fiscal discipline. Mission Formulate and implement dynamic fiscal policy and strengthen public financial management (PFM) for effective resource mobilization, efficient allocation, prudent expenditure and debt management with proper accountability of public resources. Core Values INTEGRITY and CARE (I- C.A.R.E) Integrity : We do the right thing. Collaboration : We believe in team work. Accountability : We take ownership and accountability. Respect : We value people and treat them with respect. Excellence : We give our best. Related Navigation About eCMS Vision, Mission & Values Goals & Strategies Organizational Structure Contact Us

title: eCMS Bhutan :: Web Portal of Electronic Customs Management System
content: Goals And Strategies OUR GOALS To promote honest and transparent environment, ensure efficient assessment and collection of duties and taxes and facilitate legitimate trade and commerce.
